post.description:
Creates a cancel request for a specific booking Id

Request Parameters

Attribute Type Description
metadata
bookingId String Trip id corresponding to each booked product

Response Parameters in case of successful response

Attribute Type Description
metadata
booking_id String Trip id corresponding to the booking which is to be cancelled
status String CANCELLED
items List List of items to be cancelled
id String Trip item id which is to be cancelled
status String Status of the particular item. The status will always be “CANCELLED” in case of success response.

Below response with 200 OK HttpStatus

    
    {
        "booking_id": "123",
        "status": "CANCELLED",
        "items": [
            {
                "id": "1",
                "status": "CANCELLED"
            },
            {
                "id": "2",
                "status": "CANCELLED"
            }
        ]
    }

Response Parameters in case of failure response

Attribute Type Description
metadata
booking_id String Trip id corresponding to the booking which is to be cancelled
status String FAILURE
error_code String Error code in case of failure
error_message String Error message in case of failure
items List List of items to be cancelled
id String Trip item id which is to be cancelled
status String Status of the particular item. The status can be “CANCELLED” or “FAILURE”.

Below response with 500 Internal Server Error HttpStatus

    
    {
        "booking_id": "123",
        "status": "FAILURE",
        "error_code": "EGE-ER-OS-5011",
        "error_message": "There was an error in cancelling the [1234, 9876] items. Please try again.",
        "items": [
            {
                "id": "1",
                "status": "CANCELLED"
            },
            {
                "id": "1234",
                "status": "FAILURE"
            },
            {
                "id": "9876",
                "status": "FAILURE"
            }
        ]
    }

403.description: Forbidden : User is not authorized for the operation.

404.description: Not Found : You are trying to access an invalid or non existent resource.

422.description: Invalid input : invalid or missing required input.

500.description: Internal Server Error : unable to process request

post.description:
Creates a delete request for a specific booking Id

Request Parameters

Attribute Type Description
metadata
bookingId String Trip id corresponding to each booked product

Response Parameters in case of successful response

Attribute Type Description
metadata
booking_id String Trip id corresponding to the booking which is to be deleted
status String SUCCESS
items List List of items to be deleted
id String Trip item id which is to be deleted
status String Status of the particular item. The status will be booking status of the trip item.

Below response with 200 OK HttpStatus

    
    {
        "booking_id": "123",
        "status": "SUCCESS",
        "items": [
            {
                "id": "1",
                "status": "DELETED"
            },
            {
                "id": "2",
                "status": "DELETED"
            }
        ]
    }

Response Parameters in case of failure response

Attribute Type Description
metadata
booking_id String Trip id corresponding to the booking which is to be deleted
status String FAILURE
error_code String Error code in case of deletion
error_message String Error message in case of deletion
items List List of items to be deleted
id String Trip item id which is to be deleted
status String Status of the particular item. The status will be the booking status of the trip item

Below response with 500 Internal Server Error HttpStatus

    
    {
        "booking_id": "123",
        "status": "FAILURE",
        "error_code": "EGE-ER-OS-5012",
        "error_message": "There was an error in deleting the [1234, 9876] items. Please try again.",
        "items": [
            {
                "id": "1",
                "status": "CANCELLED"
            },
            {
                "id": "1234",
                "status": "FAILURE"
            },
            {
                "id": "9876",
                "status": "FAILURE"
            }
        ]
    }
